decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 06.11.2027, which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 24/02994/FUL.Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Act 1990 and in the interest of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings and documents:Location Plan; Block Plan; TI-SHC002.005; TI-SHC002.003; TI-SHC002.004; Planning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Updated Condition The development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than 6no. residents and 4no. members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time." Reason: To minimise the impact of the development on the occupiers of neighbouring properties and to manage the surrounding road network.

The front parking area forming part of the development shall only be used for the parking of a private motor vehicle and the stated parking space shall not be used for any other purpose.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with Development Plan Policies and to prevent the introduction of activity which would be detrimental to amenity.

Notwithstanding the details hereby approved, prior to occupation a scheme of sound insulation, designed to prevent the transmission of excessive airborne and impact noise between neighbouring residential properties has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include a fully detailed noise survey and report, manufacturers specifications and attenuation measures. The development shall not be occupied until the approved scheme has been fully implemented and maintained in accordance with the manufacturers' recommendations.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring premises.  NOTE: This condition has been discharged under the application ref:25/02087/CND on 20.08.2025.

Details of 1 long stay secure and covered cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation. The approved details shall thereafter be installed and permanently retained for cycle parking.Reason: To meet adopted cycle parking standards and in the interests of sustainable transport.NOTE: This condition has been discharged under the application ref:25/02087/CND on 20.08.2025.
